findings.F1: In calm markets the 3-day return measured in 30-day daily swings is graded against the unusual 5-day move that follows: slope +0.0201 per swing unit, t 2.85, over 744 cases on 187 days. In agitated markets the same slope is +0.0048, t 0.55, over 551 cases on 165 days.
findings.F2: The calm-market grading holds on both sides over 5 days. Cases whose 3-day return is at least one swing up have an unusual move of +3.28 % (t 2.05, 96 cases, 46 days). Cases at least one swing down have −4.17 % (t −1.91, 78 cases, 35 days). The middle cases have +0.31 % (t 0.48, 570 cases). The agitated equivalents are +1.98 % (t 0.93) and −1.19 % (t −0.47).
findings.F3: A 3-day or 5-day return carries the calm-market grading better than the tested 1-day rise. Over 5 days the 1-day z gives slope t 2.53, the 3-day z gives t 2.85 and the 5-day z gives t 2.75. Over 3 days the 1-day z gives t −0.07 while the 3-day z gives t 2.05 and the 5-day z gives t 2.47. Over 10 days the 3-day z gives t 2.18 and the 5-day z gives t 2.05.
findings.F4: The calm-market slope of the 3-day z on the 5-day unusual move is positive in every trend and on every coin. By trend it is choppy +0.045 (t 2.49), falling +0.026 (t 2.24) and rising +0.025 (t 2.14). By coin it runs from +0.020 (BTC, t 1.66) to +0.048 (XRP, t 1.89). By window it is positive in 9 of 12, with w8 at −0.012 and w12 and w15 near 0.
findings.F5: The tested signal is weak because the strongest calm-market evidence sits in cases the long-only book ignores. In calm markets, days below −2 swings are followed by −3.39 % (17 cases), and 3-day falls below −2 swings by −8.98 % (t −1.83, 22 cases, 9 days). The tested idea's own size is only +0.39 % (t 0.87, 517 days).
findings.F6: Against a trade cost of 0.19 %, the calm 3-day-move cases are large. Those at least one swing up move +3.28 % unusual. Those at least one swing down move 4.17 % unusual on the short side, and about 3.5 % total after the coin's +0.64 % normal 5-day drift works against the short. So the falling side's move per case is many times the cost.

ideas.idea: In a calm market, the larger a coin's 3-day return against the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days, the further the coin keeps moving the same way over the next 5 days. This holds for rises and for falls.
ideas.consequence: In calm markets a trader goes with sharp 3-day moves on both sides, sized by the move in usual swings, and stays out of them in agitated markets.
ideas.name: calm three-day move continues

ideas.idea: In a calm market, the larger a coin's 3-day fall against the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days, the further the coin keeps falling over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader shorts calm-market 3-day falls, more the larger the fall in usual swings, in a box (calm, short) where the research holds almost nothing.
ideas.name: calm three-day fall continues
